spell.brutality_iron.annihilation.guide: Summon lances in a star around the caster. Lances apply Hexed and have a chance to explode on contact
spell.brutality_iron.brimspike.guide: Conjure a Brimspike that spins rapidly and can be shot out, damage dealt is based on time charged
spell.brutality_iron.chthonic_capsule.gu: Throw out a blood clot that explodes some time after hitting the ground. Explodes prematurely when hitting an enemy
spell.brutality_iron.stygian_step.guide: Dash forward, damaging mobs at the end of the dash
Call down God's judgement at the targeted location
spell.brutality_iron.holy_mantle.guide: Grants Grace, nullifying the next instance of damage you take, scales with level
spell.brutality_iron.light_binding.guide: Bind the target in shackles of light, halting their movement
spell.brutality_iron.sacred_oath.guide: Take a sacred oath and briefly gain Phasing.
spell.brutality_iron.sacrifice.guide: Heals nearby players, including the caster, healing is distributed evenly and any excess is transferred to the next lowest player. Prioritizes the caster
spell.brutality_iron.cosmic_cataclysm.gu: Call down a massive meteor, causing a shockwave on impact
spell.brutality_iron.gravitokinesis.guid: Pulls targeted mobs towards the caster, can be inverted by crouching, knocking mobs away while pushing back the player
spell.brutality_iron.meteor_shower.guide: Calls down a continuous barrage of meteors at the target location
spell.brutality_iron.singularity_shift.g: Throw a star that spawns a field of augmented gravity upon impact. Gravity direction can be changed by shifting
spell.brutality_iron.star_burst.guide: Unleashes a burst of stars at the targeted direction
spell.brutality_iron.star_stream.guide: Unleashes a continuous barrage of stars at the targeted location
spell.brutality_iron.moonlit_mending.gui: Heals the caster depending on the time of day (Noon = 10% Max ❤ Health | Midnight 100% Max ❤ Health) excess healing is converted into absorption level
spell.brutality_iron.nightfall.guide: Temporarily makes it midnight, nearby mobs are inflicted with Slowness and Blindness
spell.brutality_iron.dematerialize.guide: Deal dissolution damage when the target is below the health threshold; spell resistance applies.
spell.brutality_iron.edge_of_oblivion.gu: Release an expanding antimatter wave that pushes back and damages nearby creatures.
Throw a collapsing singularity that draws in nearby mobs and deals AoE damage
spell.brutality_iron.spatial_rupture.gui: Conjure a ripple in space, knocking back nearby mobs and damaging them
spell.brutality_iron.void_walk.guide: Blink instantly to a targeted location within range
death.attack.brutality_iron.nihility.pla: %1$s was slain by %2$s using Nihility magic
death.attack.brutality_iron.celestia.pla: %1$s was slain by %2$s using Celestia magic
death.attack.brutality_iron.inferno.play: %1$s was slain by %2$s using Inferno magic
spell.brutality_iron.event_horizon.guide: Summon a following black hole that pulls and damages nearby enemies. Recast to dismiss it.
spell.brutality_iron.cruel_sun.guide: Summon a sun above you that deals spell-power-scaled Celestia damage each second. Recast to dismiss it.
spell.brutality_iron.triple_judgment.gui: Unfold three ground circles ahead, from near to far, then bring down holy columns that repeatedly damage enemies.
spell.brutality_iron.triple_profane_beam: Unfold three eldritch ground circles ahead, from near to far, then bring down violet columns that repeatedly damage enemies.
spell.brutality_iron.stygian_souls.guide: Form all souls behind you at once, then launch them one by one at visible enemies, applying Weakness.
spell.brutality_iron.crystal_sanctuary.g: Place an enlarged crystal circle slightly above the ground, granting Regeneration to you and your allies.
spell.brutality_iron.pestilent_mist.guid: Create a continuously billowing volume of plague mist at the aimed location, infecting and damaging enemies inside.
spell.brutality_iron.celestial_guard.gui: Summon three rings. Each blocks one attack exceeding 6 damage and repels nearby monsters.
